'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Nick Jones LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: copies shown by down-arrows across blank lines; objective Hidden Base on #2 (#1 is Anger, Fear, Aggression)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' The Quick
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
